Build an fdata object from AEMET daily data

Source: R/aemet2fdata.R
aemet2fdata.Rd

Builds an fdata object (package fda.usc) with one curve per station-year and 365 points per curve.

Data can be provided in three ways:

  • from an existing data.frame using df

  • from a file using file (.csv, .RData, .rds)

  • by downloading data from AEMET through aemet2df

Usage

aemet2fdata(
  station_id = NULL,
  var,
  start_date = NULL,
  end_date = NULL,
  last_n_days = 30,
  api_key = NULL,
  df = NULL,
  file = NULL,
  output_file = NULL,
  verbose = FALSE,
  control = list()
)

Arguments

station_id

Character. AEMET station identifier(s). Required when downloading from the API; with df or file it filters stations.

var

Character. A single variable name, for example "tmed", "prec", "tmin" or "tmax".

start_date

Character or Date. Initial date in "YYYY-MM-DD" format.

end_date

Character or Date. Final date in "YYYY-MM-DD" format.

last_n_days

Integer. Number of last days to download if no dates are provided. Default: 30.

api_key

Character. AEMET OpenData API key. Used only if data are downloaded from the API.

df

Optional data.frame with columns fecha (or date), station_id and var, as returned by aemet2df.

file

NULL, a file (.csv, .RData, .rds), a vector of files or a directory (e.g. the out_dir of aemet2download).

output_file

NULL or character path to save the resulting fdata object. Supported extensions are .RData and .rds.

verbose

Logical. If TRUE, prints progress messages.

control

List of advanced parameters passed to aemet2df when downloading from the API.

Value

An object of class fdata with one row per station-year and 365 columns.

Details

Only numeric meteorological variables are converted into functional data. The output has one row per station-year (row names "station_year", e.g. "1387_2023") and 365 columns, the days of the year (argvals = 1:365).

Leap years: February 29 is removed and the following days are shifted back one position, so column 60 is always March 1. Missing daily values are kept as NA.

Variable labels and units are assigned from internal AEMET metadata, e.g.

  • tmed: main = "temperature_mean", ylab = "Mean daily temperature (°C)"

  • prec: main = "precipitation", ylab = "Daily precipitation (mm)"

See also

aemet2lfdata, fdata

Examples

# Example data shipped with the package (2 stations, 2023-2024)
f <- system.file("extdata", "aemet_example.csv", package = "aemet2fdata")

fd <- aemet2fdata(file = f, var = "tmed")
fd
